admission.justification: Future changes to host intake, task projection or task-status consumers must preserve this bounded authority: duplicate task truth, unsupported paused observations, reconstructed membership or conflicting status/age presentation produce incorrect task operations. The named current source assertions guard the specified facets; this is no fresh Curator execution grade.

applicability: Native task stage, started-task host activity and its contributing event timestamp computed by task_state.
conditions: Document planning/inProgress/abandoned/Completed normalize to planned/started/aborted/completed; non-started stage takes precedence and has no activity/event time.
An unqualified host observation gives started/unknown, not paused; in-turn or permission gives works, otherwise a complete host observation gives paused.
The latest timestamp among the working contributors, or all observed contributors when paused, supplies eventAt; display age derives from that timestamp, not a serialized elapsed-age field.
exclusions: Task body hydration, dependency readiness, worktree/process phase and session records are not additional task-stage authorities.
No guaranteed timestamp when the host supplied none, and no ageSeconds field in the task-entry wire model.
statement: Each task's document stage and bound-host activity determine its only stage/activity/age facts, with a permission prompt counting as work.
